declaration.rejection_rule: axes that depend on resolving individual flakes are rejected at declaration

REFLECTION_EDGE_SHARPNESS.formula: p95 of adjacent-cell gradient of the CONTRAST-NORMALISED planar grid
REFLECTION_EDGE_SHARPNESS.note: normalising by contrast decorrelates it from amplitude

REFLECTION_COHERENCE.formula: fraction of planar-grid variance captured by an 8x8 low-frequency downsample — coherent bands score high, speckle scores low

ENVIRONMENT_CORRELATION.formula: Pearson correlation of the normalised planar grid with the MIRROR REFERENCE planar grid

GRAZING_REFLECTION_RESPONSE.note: same formula as REFLECTED_PATTERN_CONTRAST on another region; counted as SUPPORTING, never as the second independent axis

independence_note: independence on this rig is measured by the DECLARED parameter-sweep instrument (sweep/sweep_declaration.json): metallic_response and flake_density swept within SHIMMER, abs Spearman across levels, ceiling 0.80, with the asymmetric reading declared in advance — divergence measures independence; tracking on all sweeps is treated conservatively as not-both-countable.
pending_independence_note: the reflective census is N=2-by-declaration and cannot grow (the rig declares exactly two families); within-rig independence is therefore a hashed declaration, not a measurement — the exact property R5 exists to stop anyone asserting. Marked PASS_PENDING_INDEPENDENCE until the declared parameter-sweep instrument measures it one way or the other.
